hyperedges.label: Keep Uncertain Amounts Out of Totals

nodes.label: Egyptian Wallet Types (Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, Orange Cash, Etisalat Cash/Fawry)
nodes.norm_label: egyptian wallet types (vodafone cash, instapay, orange cash, etisalat cash/fawry)

nodes.label: Excel (.xlsx) Report Import
nodes.rationale: Header detection in Arabic/English, preview before save, flexible amount/date formats, skips totals rows; imported rows marked hand-entered so rescans never reclassify and re-import is idempotent.

nodes.label: Free Gemini Model Picker
nodes.rationale: Lists models available to the key, hides non-text models, marks free-tier families (flash / flash-lite / gemma).

nodes.label: Gemini AI Classification
nodes.rationale: Model prompted as an expert Egyptian-wallet financial analyst returning type, direction, confidence and reason as JSON; stored in ai/ai_note so SMS scans never re-parse it away.

nodes.label: Native Kotlin Code (SMS access and reminder)
nodes.norm_label: native kotlin code (sms access and reminder)
nodes.rationale: Used instead of third-party plugins; only file_selector and excel packages are added.

nodes.label: Daily Opening Balance Prompt
nodes.rationale: Pre-filled with the last balance seen in SMS before that day.

nodes.label: Needs Review View (تحتاج مراجعة)
nodes.rationale: Pending/unknown operations stay out of totals until the user confirms with تأكيد واحتساب; nothing is guessed.

nodes.label: setup.sh Build Setup
nodes.rationale: Generates android/, installs native Kotlin code from native/, adds permissions and receivers, runs flutter pub get.

nodes.label: SIM and Wallet Selection (شرائحك ومحافظك)
nodes.rationale: Only messages for chosen wallets are stored.

nodes.label: Linking Messages to Wallet Numbers
nodes.rationale: Matched by wallet type; with dual SIM of the same type, the SIM chosen in setup decides; unchosen wallet types are skipped.

nodes.label: Parser, Importer and Gemini Tests
nodes.rationale: Real redacted messages added to test/parser_test.dart to tune rules; importer and model answer parsing tested in test/importer_test.dart and test/gemini_test.dart.

nodes.label: Transaction Filters (wallet, type, date, in/out)
nodes.rationale: Single date shortcut at a time; local calendar days; custom ranges inclusive; filters combine; types are alternatives within the type filter.

nodes.label: Amwali (أموالي) Wallet Log App
nodes.rationale: Flutter Android app for a currency trader receiving many transfers on several wallet numbers; reads wallet SMS into one transaction log, stored locally.

nodes.label: Accuracy Safeguards
nodes.rationale: OTP, failed, rejected, pending and promo messages ignored; only transfers and explicit deductions auto-counted; rules built from offered operations because SMS templates are not public.

nodes.label: Printed Balance Continuity Check
nodes.rationale: A gap between consecutive printed balances flags a missing/deleted message or a mis-read amount.

nodes.label: AI Confidence Threshold 0.6
nodes.rationale: Classifications below 0.6 or without a direction stay in review so no amount enters totals by mistake.

nodes.label: Deduction Rule (وخصم X من محفظتك)
nodes.rationale: Any message with this phrase counts X as money leaving the wallet, even when it also mentions transfer/top-up/bill.

nodes.label: Known Limits (Android only, read on open, per-phone data)
nodes.norm_label: known limits (android only, read on open, per-phone data)
nodes.rationale: iOS does not allow apps to read SMS; messages read only when app opens; multi-phone dashboard would need a shared server; AI needs internet and free quotas are limited.

nodes.label: Local SQLite Storage (privacy)
nodes.rationale: Everything stays on the phone; only SMS texts the user chooses to classify are sent to Google.

nodes.label: graphify Skill (/graphify trigger)
nodes.rationale: Installed skill at .claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md turns any input into a knowledge graph; must be used before anything else when the user types /graphify.

nodes.label: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.rationale: Read only for broad architecture review or when query/path/explain do not surface enough context.

nodes.label: graph.json Whole-Rewrite Policy
nodes.rationale: graph.json is rewritten whole on every build, so large PR diffs are expected and must not be flagged as churn.

nodes.label: Query Graph Before Grep/Read Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; the rule must be propagated to every code-exploring subagent prompt.

nodes.label: graphify update After Code Changes
nodes.rationale: AST-only update keeps the graph current with no API cost.
